epic: value-bearing blocked-by:N labels with GHA auto-cleanup and migration

stories.title: value-bearing blocked-by:N labels with GHA auto-cleanup and migration
stories.description: Replace the boolean `blocked by` / `blocking` labels with value-bearing `blocked-by:N` / `blocking:N` labels (one label per referenced issue number), add a GitHub Actions webhook that removes stale `blocked-by:N` labels the moment a blocker closes, add a `promote-ready` reconcile pass as a safety net, handle reopen, and migrate all existing `blocked by` / `blocking` labels.

Given the feature is implemented
When the behaviour is exercised
Then `to-issues` emits `blocked-by:N` (one label per blocker) instead of holé `blocked by`; emits `blocking:N` (one label per dependent) retroactively instead of holé `blocking`

Given the feature is implemented
When the behaviour is exercised
Then `seed-issue` accepts `--blocked-by N,M`; emits `blocked-by:N` / `blocked-by:M`; retroactively patches `blocking:ISSUE` on upstream issues

Given the feature is implemented
When the behaviour is exercised
Then `label-taxonomy.md` documents the new `blocked-by:N` / `blocking:N` pattern, removal lifecycle, and deprecation of holé labels

Given the feature is implemented
When the behaviour is exercised
Then `blocked-by-cleanup.yml` GHA workflow triggers on `issues: [closed]`; removes `blocked-by:N` from all open dependents; promotes fully-unblocked dependents to Ready; removes `blocking:DEPENDENT` from the closed issue when its dependents are clear

Given the feature is implemented
When the behaviour is exercised
Then `blocked-by-cleanup.yml` triggers on `issues: [reopened]`; re-adds `blocked-by:N` to dependents that were unblocked by this issue; demotes them back to Blocked

Given the feature is implemented
When the behaviour is exercised
Then `promote-ready.sh` reconcile pass removes stale `blocked-by:N` labels where N is closed; promotes fully-unblocked issues

Given the feature is implemented
When the behaviour is exercised
Then `migrate-blocked-by-labels.sh` converts all existing `blocked by` / `blocking` issues; `--dry-run` mode supported; script is idempotent
